public_rationale: The required conditions have not been established for a post-publication operation in the records found. Later reporting supplies relevant evidence about the February 28 Minab strike, but that event preceded the March 8 forecast. It cannot resolve the forecast early. The conditional forecast is therefore not adjudicable at this freeze; this is not a finding that the warning is false.
limitations: The strongest incident reporting concerns an earlier event.
The investigation account is partly secondhand and includes disputed attribution.
Even a qualifying incident would support occurrence, not a universal guarantee.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If the humans in the loop are overtaxed and overtrust the AI, serious targeting errors are inevitable.
conditions: if humans are overtaxed choosing many targets rapidly

statement.excerpt: But if the humans are overtaxed (choosing many targets) rapidly, and wind up overtrusting the technology, serious errors are still inevitable.
statement.document_title: There are no heroes in commercial AI

our_interpretation: Treat this as a conditional forecast about subsequent AI-assisted targeting operations.
Both human overload and excessive reliance on AI must be established in the same operation.
A serious error means a materially mistaken targeting decision causing or threatening grave harm.
The ordinary occurrence reading predicts that serious errors will occur under these conditions. One incident cannot establish universal inevitability.
criteria.support_condition: A documented post-publication operation satisfies both conditions and produces a serious targeting error linked to them.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A finite error-free period cannot refute an undated prediction of eventual errors. Contradiction would require a clearly bounded interpretation and evidence that it failed; none is supplied here.
